47	   and confirmed is about the same problem.

56	   issue names the package only inside pasted tool output.

58	   duplicate. Mention a real related issue as `#NNNN` in your comment, never as a URL
59	   (a URL to an upstream issue would post a cross-reference on it).

113	   tests styles and colours against Rich's own parser, so if it rejects one,
114	   the suggestion is wrong; change the advice, do not drop the check. Post the
115	   checked text unchanged.

When building tables in a CLI program I am working on, I have varying sized tables that are smaller than the console width. }
